LESSON: JUM’AH FESTIVALS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: ISLAMIC
Topic 7.1: Jum’ah FESTIVALS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Jum’ah FESTIVALS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Perform the sunnah acts of jum’ah in order to attain preparation for Jum’ah prayers.rewards from Allah
2. Appreciate Jum’ah as the Eid of the week. muslims performing Jum’ah prayer.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Perform the sunnah acts of jum’ah in order to attain preparation for Jum’ah prayers.rewards from Allah
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform the sunnah acts of jum’ah in order to attain preparation for Jum’ah prayers.rewards from Allah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate Jum’ah as the Eid of the week. muslims performing Jum’ah prayer.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Jum’ah as the Eid of the week. muslims performing Jum’ah prayer. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Jum’ah FESTIVALS.
2. Explain Jum’ah FESTIVALS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners role play the Jum’ah prayer? preparation for Jum’ah activities of Jum’ah. 3. How do you dress when prayers.rewards from Allah
4. Show that you can: Perform the sunnah acts of jum’ah in order to attain preparation for Jum’ah prayers.rewards from Allah
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jum’ah FESTIVALS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Jum’ah FESTIVALS important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners role play the Jum’ah prayer? preparation for Jum’ah activities of Jum’ah. 3. How do you dress when prayers.rewards from Allah
2. Learners draw and colour a going for Jum’ah prayers? c) Appreciate Jum’ah as the Eid mosque. 4. Who leads the Jum’ah of the week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Perform the sunnah acts of jum’ah in order to attain preparation for Jum’ah prayers.rewards from Allah
2. Appreciate Jum’ah as the Eid of the week. muslims performing Jum’ah prayer.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
